notes: The 2026 workshop ran July 12 to 25. Applications for 2026 are closed. The page does not mention when the 2027 application opens.
name: LLRISE Radar Workshop
what_you_do: Two-week summer radar workshop run by MIT Lincoln Laboratory, held at MIT and at Lincoln Lab. Students live in MIT dorms.
who_can_apply: High school students completing their junior year who are US citizens. Permanent residents who are not citizens are not eligible.
pay_detail: Free. Students pay only their own travel to and from MIT. Housing is in MIT dorms. Transport to Lincoln Lab is provided.
duration: 2 weeks (2026: July 12 to 25), living in MIT dorms
deadline_text: 2026 cycle: applications closed March 11, 2026 (10 p.m. ET). Recommendations due March 18. Decisions mid-May. 2027 dates not posted.
how_to_apply: Apply online by the deadline and have recommendations sent in. Contact details are on the page.
